title: Visual design of your website or application
slide_intent: Explain how visual resemblance can affect perceived authorship. An interface that looks like its platform provider can leave a visitor unsure who created it.
strategic_value: Slack can help third-party services disclose their relationship to its platform while keeping their own visual identity distinct.
demonstration: Four lettered paragraphs describe site appearance, use of Slack web assets, API-service attribution and the presentation of a requested notice.
practical_value: Consult this historical page when interpreting how the edition handled independent service identity and notice visibility. It specifies initial-view placement, size and opacity for a requested notice.

content_islands.name: Appearance provisions
content_islands.spec: Place two lettered paragraphs in the upper-left text block under the title rule. Address visual imitation and the display of Slack site elements.

content_islands.name: Attribution and notice
content_islands.spec: Follow with two paragraphs covering the API relationship and visibility of a requested notice. Keep the right field open.
